name: goss-package-dependency-closure-validation
instr:
Let Goss validate that a declared set of installed packages has a complete, version-compatible runtime dependency closure. Relationship data must reflect the selected host package manager while supporting alternatives, virtual capabilities, cycles, recursive configuration, and concurrent validation. Existing package-only configurations must remain observationally unchanged.

The `github.com/goss-org/goss/system` package exports `Package`, `PackageRelationshipReport`, `PackageRequirement`, and `PackageCapability`; each isolated report carries Name, Version, ordered Requirements with Alternatives, and Provides whose capabilities retain Name, Operator, and Version. DebPackage, AlpinePackage, PacmanPackage, RpmPackage, and NullPackage relationships preserve their native required-dependency, alternative, version, provider, and error semantics while excluding recommendations, conflicts, optional dependencies, installation metadata, and internal query artifacts from mandatory closure. NullPackage relationship inspection returns the existing unavailable-manager error and no usable report. Closure succeeds exactly when every reachable mandatory relationship from an installed member has one compatible installed provider; external providers may satisfy capabilities without becoming traversal roots, and every edge has one deterministic result.
